subjects.name: 天文学
subjects.eyebrow: 从地球出发，重新认识宇宙
subjects.description: 从太阳系走向恒星与宇宙，打开独立演示，观察天体、尺度与探索任务。
subjects.description_en: Explore the Solar System, stars, and the wider universe through standalone visual lessons.

topics.name: 太阳系
topics.description: 认识八颗行星、太阳系的层次，并体验天王星下降与地火转移。
topics.description_en: Explore eight planets, the Solar System’s layers, Uranus, and a journey to Mars.

lessons.name: 太阳系行星图鉴
lessons.description: 旋转、靠近并观察太阳与行星。
lessons.description_en: Rotate, zoom in, and observe the Sun and planets.
lessons.interaction: 3D 漫游 · 天体资料

lessons.name: 太阳系结构
lessons.description: 从行星轨道走向柯伊伯带与奥尔特云。
lessons.description_en: Travel from planetary orbits to the Kuiper Belt and Oort Cloud.
lessons.interaction: 尺度图解 · 光行时

lessons.name: 落入天王星
lessons.description: 沿着探测器的下降路径，观察天王星的大气层。
lessons.description_en: Follow a probe’s descent through the atmosphere of Uranus.
lessons.interaction: 交互模拟 · 大气分层

lessons.name: 地球到火星
lessons.description: 观察一次简化的地火转移任务。
lessons.description_en: Explore a simplified Earth-to-Mars transfer mission.
lessons.interaction: 轨道转移 · 任务时间

topics.name: 宇宙现象
topics.description: 从宇宙早期与黑洞，继续探索暗物质、暗能量和宇宙膨胀。
topics.description_en: Explore the early universe, black holes, dark matter, dark energy, and cosmic expansion.

lessons.name: 宇宙大爆炸
lessons.description: 沿时间线认识早期宇宙的演化。
lessons.description_en: Follow a timeline of the early universe.
lessons.interaction: 交互时间线 · 宇宙演化

lessons.name: 黑洞
lessons.description: 观察黑洞附近光与空间的教学示意。
lessons.description_en: Explore a visual model of light and space near a black hole.
lessons.interaction: 3D 演示 · 引力

lessons.name: 暗物质与暗能量
lessons.description: 通过交互场景探索宇宙的质能组成、暗物质的引力效应与暗能量。
lessons.description_en: Explore the cosmic mass-energy budget, gravitational evidence for dark matter, and dark energy.
lessons.interaction: WebGL2 · 宇宙组成 · 参数探索

topics.name: 恒星与星空
topics.description: 认识恒星的大小、光谱与一生，并探索星座图解。
topics.description_en: Study star sizes, spectra, life cycles, and constellation patterns.

lessons.name: 恒星图鉴
lessons.description: 比较恒星大小、光谱类型与演化阶段。
lessons.description_en: Compare star sizes, spectral types, and evolutionary stages.
lessons.interaction: 图鉴 · 赫罗图

lessons.name: 星座图解
lessons.description: 在星空图上辨认星座，并了解视角与距离。
lessons.description_en: Find constellations and compare apparent patterns with distance.
lessons.interaction: 星空图解 · 交互观察

topics.name: 登月探索
topics.description: 从月球轨道与月相开始，再观察日食、月食和人类登月。
topics.description_en: Explore lunar orbits and phases, solar and lunar eclipses, and the human Moon landing.

lessons.name: 人类登月
lessons.description: 通过交互场景了解登月任务与月面环境。
lessons.description_en: Explore a Moon landing mission and the lunar surface.
lessons.interaction: 3D 场景 · 任务过程

lessons.name: 月相与食
lessons.description: 切换月相、日食与月食，观察太阳、地球和月球的几何关系。
lessons.description_en: Switch between lunar phases and eclipses to explore the Sun–Earth–Moon geometry.
lessons.interaction: WebGL2 · 月相 · 日食与月食
lessons.interaction_en: WebGL2 · Lunar phases · Solar and lunar eclipses

subjects.name: 物理学
subjects.description: 从汽车的受力与运动，走向简单机械，再探索电与磁。
subjects.description_en: Explore forces and motion, simple machines, then electricity and magnetism.

topics.name: 力与运动
topics.description: 通过一辆可操作的 3D 汽车，观察受力图与牛顿三大定律。
topics.description_en: Use an interactive 3D car to study force diagrams and Newton's three laws.

lessons.name: 牛顿车库
lessons.description: 切换运动状态、调节质量与驱动力，完成五章互动实验与课堂挑战。
lessons.description_en: Change motion states, mass, and driving force across five interactive chapters.
lessons.interaction: 3D 汽车 · 双语 · 五章实验

topics.name: 简单机械
topics.description: 通过六种可操作的三维机械，观察力、距离与功之间的关系。
topics.description_en: Explore six interactive 3D machines and the relationships among force, distance, and work.

lessons.name: 简单机械 3D 实验室
lessons.description: 操作杠杆、滑轮、轮轴、斜面、螺旋与楔子，调节参数并观察示意受力。
lessons.description_en: Operate levers, pulleys, wheels and axles, inclines, screws, and wedges; adjust parameters and inspect forces.
lessons.interaction: 6 个章节 · 3D 操作 · 中英双语

topics.name: 电与磁
topics.description: 从静电与磁现象出发，探索电流、电路、电磁感应及电功率。
topics.description_en: Explore static electricity, magnetism, current, circuits, induction, and electric power.

lessons.name: 电与磁 3D 实验室
lessons.description: 通过 13 个互动章节观察电磁现象，搭建电路并调节实验参数。
lessons.description_en: Explore 13 interactive chapters, assemble circuits, and adjust experiment parameters.
lessons.interaction: 13 个章节 · 3D 操作 · 中英双语

subjects.name: 生物学
subjects.description: 从细胞、人体系统到生命活动，观察生命结构与功能。
subjects.description_en: Explore life from cells and organ systems to the processes that sustain living things.
subjects.status: 植物细胞、动物细胞、细菌与病毒等生物学演示已逐步开放
subjects.status_en: Biology lessons on plant and animal cells, bacteria, viruses, and more are opening progressively

topics.name: 细胞世界
topics.description: 从植物与动物细胞，到细菌和病毒，对照三维结构、形态与显微图像。
topics.description_en: Compare plant and animal cells, bacteria, and viruses through 3D structures, morphology, and micrographs.
topics.status: 植物细胞、动物细胞、细菌与病毒图鉴已开放 · 细胞图鉴本地预览
topics.status_en: Plant cell, animal cell, bacteria, and virus lessons available · Cell Atlas local preview

lessons.name: 植物细胞模型
lessons.description: 旋转植物细胞，点选 11 种细胞器查看结构与功能。细胞器大小和位置经过视觉化处理。
lessons.description_en: Rotate the plant cell and select 11 organelles to explore their structures and roles. Organelle sizes and positions are visualized, not to scale.
lessons.interaction: 11 种细胞器 · WebGL 2 · 3D 交互

lessons.name: 动物细胞模型
lessons.description: 旋转并剖切动物细胞，点选 16 种结构查看中英文说明；模型尺寸经过视觉化处理。
lessons.description_en: Rotate and section an animal cell, then select 16 structures for bilingual explanations. Model dimensions are visualized.
lessons.interaction: 16 种结构 · Three.js · 中英切换

lessons.name: 细菌图鉴
lessons.description: 探索 12 种细菌与六类形态，旋转程序生成的群体模型，并查看逐张署名的显微图像。
lessons.description_en: Explore 12 bacterial specimens across six morphological groups, rotate procedural models, and compare credited micrographs.
lessons.interaction: 12 个标本 · 6 类群 · 3D · 显微图像

lessons.name: 病毒图鉴
lessons.description: 探索七类代表病毒的结构、基因组与复制策略，并对照真实电子显微镜图像。
lessons.description_en: Explore the structures, genomes, and replication strategies of seven representative viruses, alongside electron micrographs.
lessons.interaction: 7 种病毒 · 3D 模型 · 电镜对照 · 来源署名
lessons.interaction_en: 7 viruses · 3D models · Micrograph comparison · Image credits

lessons.name: 细胞形态图鉴
lessons.description: 观察 26 个标本的三维示意结构，并与显微图像并排比较。演示正文目前为中文。
lessons.description_en: Explore 26 interactive specimens alongside microscope images. The lesson text is currently in Chinese.
lessons.interaction: 3D 旋转 · 剖切 · 显微对照

topics.name: 细胞能量
topics.description: 从线粒体和叶绿体的结构出发，理解有氧呼吸与光合作用。
topics.description_en: Connect mitochondrion and chloroplast structures to aerobic respiration and photosynthesis.

lessons.name: 细胞能量图鉴
lessons.description: 探索线粒体、叶绿体、呼吸、发酵与光合作用，并查看两张独立的 AI 教学结构图。
lessons.description_en: Explore mitochondria, chloroplasts, respiration, fermentation, and photosynthesis with two separate AI teaching illustrations.
lessons.interaction: 3D 结构 · 分步过程 · 双语 · 两张功能图
lessons.interaction_en: 3D structures · Step-by-step pathways · Bilingual · Two illustrations

topics.name: 人体系统
topics.description: 以交互式三维人体观察九大系统与代表器官，了解结构如何支持生命活动。
topics.description_en: Explore nine organ systems and representative organs in an interactive 3D human model.

lessons.name: 人体系统图鉴
lessons.description: 旋转人体模型、切换系统、剖切结构并点选器官，查看中英文说明。
lessons.description_en: Rotate the body, switch systems, clip the model, and select organs for bilingual explanations.
lessons.interaction: 9 大系统 · WebGL 交互 · 中英切换

subjects.name: 化学
subjects.description: 从原子模型的演进出发，继续探索溶液、酸碱与物质变化。
subjects.description_en: Explore atomic models, solutions, acids and bases, and how matter changes.

topics.name: 原子结构
topics.description: 沿着 2400 年时间线观察八种原子模型与关键实验。
topics.description_en: Follow a 2,400-year timeline of atomic models and the experiments that reshaped them.

lessons.name: 原子模型2400年
lessons.description: 沿着时间线观察八种原子模型与关键实验，理解科学证据如何改写原子理论。
lessons.description_en: Follow eight atomic models and the experiments that changed our understanding of atoms.
lessons.interaction: 八种模型 · 六次范式转移 · 中英切换

topics.name: 溶液与酸碱
topics.description: 通过溶液、分散系、溶解度、电离与中和等交互场景，观察微观粒子的变化。
topics.description_en: Explore interactive scenes on solutions, dispersions, solubility, ionization, and neutralization.

lessons.name: 溶液与酸碱微观实验台
lessons.description: 切换九个微观实验场景，探索溶解、丁达尔效应、溶解度曲线、电离、中和、pH 与方程式配平。
lessons.description_en: Explore nine microscopic lab scenes on dissolving, the Tyndall effect, solubility, ionization, neutralization, pH, and equation balancing.
lessons.interaction: 9 个可操作场景 · 中英文切换

topics.name: 元素周期表
topics.description: 搜索并点开 118 种元素，查看原子模型、单质照片、常见化合物和同位素，沿着元素性质理解周期律。
topics.description_en: Search and explore all 118 elements through atomic models, substance photographs, compounds, isotopes, and periodic trends.
topics.status: 118 种元素 · 平面与 3D 视图

lessons.name: 元素周期表
lessons.description: 搜索、筛选并点选元素，查看原子结构、物理性质、同位素、常见化合物与单质照片。
lessons.description_en: Search, filter, and select elements to explore atomic structure, physical properties, isotopes, compounds, and photographs of the substances.
lessons.interaction: 118 种元素 · 2D / 3D · 中英文切换
